name: project-operations
description: Poppy is a personal Codex partner with focused skills for verified delivery, semantic continuity, authorized operational learning, and organized closure.

interface.longDescription: Poppy preserves the user's outcome, routes one focused owner for context, intake, decisions, coordination, research, diagnosis, delivery, acceptance, assurance, learning, semantic continuity, authorized operational evidence, or Codex housekeeping, acts within explicit authority, and verifies consequential claims. Root Poppy recommends Scribe when continuity risk or a material correction makes later analysis useful. Optional bounded hooks provide lifecycle guards only.
defaultPrompt: Poppy, turn this rough idea into a recommendation, then implement the selected outcome.
Poppy, diagnose this defect and verify the fix.
Poppy, tell me what needs doing next, make it decision-ready, and include Scribe when continuity or later analysis would help.
